notes: Comcast's FY2024 10-K gives no employee, store or network figures by state or country. The only geographic workforce figure is that approximately 30% of its ~182,000 employees (FTE basis) were in over 30 countries outside the U.S., recorded as one region; the filing names the UK, Western Europe, East Asia and South Asia as larger concentrations without numbers. Sites are those Item 2 (Properties) and the Theme Parks segment description name. A web search for Comcast state impact pages found only older, partial state fact sheets (e.g. Utah 2016, New Mexico 2017), which were not opened; no state rows are recorded. Period: Dec 31, 2024.
